rows.what_the_ink_shows: The rotated margin note is headed “Critère numérique” and specifies “X irred de dim d”. Under a brace, its first line visibly says D.C > 0 for C an irreducible curve; its second line says D^d > 0. Both inequalities and the superscript d are clear. No general positive-dimensional V or its restricted self-intersection appears. See crops/14_scan094_L271_margin_rotated.jpg, derived from crops/14_scan094_L271_margin_raw.jpg by a recorded clockwise 90-degree rotation.
rows.note: Written: the two conditions D.C > 0 for irreducible curves and D^d > 0, presented as a numerical criterion for irreducible X of dimension d. Proposed mathematical correction supplied by the row: require (D restricted to V)^{dim V} > 0 for every integral closed V of positive dimension; the two displayed tests suffice in the surface case but do not give the general higher-dimensional criterion. Preserve the manuscript’s two-condition note. The supplied projective-bundle counterexample and reference to Pro note P05 were not independently checked in this page-only review.

rows.event_outcome: Visually collated the full assigned scan and an enlarged, contrast-raised margin crop, rotated clockwise for legibility with the transformation recorded in its .crop.json sidecar. Confirmed the two written inequalities and absence of the proposed universal-V condition. This was textual collation; no Nakai-Moishezon proof or counterexample derivation was performed.

main_reader_review: Inspected the full page and rotated numerical-criterion crop. The manuscript explicitly writes the curve condition and D^d>0, with no universal-V condition. Accepted b; no change to the manuscript criterion.
